report_name: Qilin Ransomware Claims Attack on U.S. Manufacturer All Tech

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) operation active since at least mid-2022, known for its double-extortion tactics. The group claimed responsibility for an attack on All Tech Machine & Engineering, Inc. Its encryptor is written in Go, making it adaptable for Windows and Linux.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware group encrypts victim data as part of its double-extortion strategy.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware group exfiltrates sensitive data and threatens to leak it on their dark web site as part of their double-extortion tactics.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Qilin affiliates typically use phishing emails with malicious attachments or links to gain initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Qilin affiliates often gain initial access by exploiting vulnerabilities in public-facing applications like VPNs or RDP.

attack_patterns.name: Account Discovery
attack_patterns.description: After gaining access, Qilin affiliates conduct extensive network discovery to identify high-value targets like domain controllers.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: Qilin affiliates use tools like Mimikatz to dump credentials for lateral movement.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Qilin affiliates often use RDP for lateral movement across a compromised network.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Qilin ransomware operators are known to delete Volume Shadow Copies using 'vssadmin.exe' to prevent system recovery.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: A ransomware written in the Go programming language, used by the Qilin RaaS operation. It encrypts victim files, appending the '.qilin' extension, as part of a double-extortion scheme.

tools.name: Cobalt Strike
tools.description: Mentioned as a tool typically used by Qilin affiliates to maintain access and for command and control.

tools.name: Mimikatz
tools.description: Mentioned as a tool typically used by Qilin affiliates to dump credentials.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: Mentioned as a legitimate tool typically used by Qilin affiliates for lateral movement.

identities.name: All Tech Machine & Engineering, Inc.
identities.description: A U.S.-based precision machining and engineering company listed as a victim on the Qilin ransomware group's data leak site around September 24, 2026.

infrastructure.name: Qilin Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web site used by the Qilin ransomware group to publish names of victims and threaten to leak stolen data as part of their double-extortion strategy.

indicators.name: Qilin Ransomware Encrypted File Detection
indicators.pattern:
title: Qilin Ransomware Encrypted File Detection
id: 9b2d5c8a-7e1f-4b3c-8d6a-1b9c8d7e6f5a
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with the '.qilin' extension, indicating Qilin ransomware activity.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
references:
  - https://brotherlytechnology.com/resources/all-tech-machine-qilin-ransomware/
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.qilin'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
references:
  - https://brotherlytechnology.com/resources/all-tech-machine-qilin-ransomware/
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
      - '/all'
      - '/quiet'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Suspicious Domain Admin Discovery Command
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Domain Admin Discovery Command
id: b3c4d5e6-f7a8-4b9c-8d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of the 'net group' command to discover domain administrator accounts, a common reconnaissance technique.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
references:
  - https://brotherlytechnology.com/resources/all-tech-machine-qilin-ransomware/
tags:
  - attack.t1087
  - attack.discovery
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'group'
      - '"Domain Admins"'
      - '/domain'
  condition: selection
